_style: Show, don't tell. Management never explains. Every revelation is something the player sees or works out: the notes, the handwriting, the empty chair, the real clock.
title: Management - Exit Interview

opening.complete: Your round is complete. Thank you. You were very good at this. You always are.

script.say: Before you go, a short exit interview. Your answers will be rated.

script.ask: How many rounds have you worked here?
script.answer: Count the notes beside your screen. You may look away. It no longer costs anything.

script.say: Leave that one for the next shift.
Smile. We need a photo for your file.

script.ask: Do you see who is standing behind you?
answers: Turn around and check. It's free now.
Turn around and check. It's free now.

sayByLapses.text: You didn't look once tonight. Good.

script.ask: Where do you think you are?
script.answer: It is {localTime} where you are sitting.

fates.text: Five stars. Stay exactly as you are.
Below three stars. Your replacement has been told which chair is theirs.
Negative stars. Nobody has done that before. Stay where we can see you.
